summary.intent: Execute all 14 plans of GSD phase 68.1 (wiring CipherBox's v2.0 web app onto the node/v3 read+write chain, replacing 46 runtime stubs) via wave-based parallel subagents, verify against the exit criterion of a fully green 208-spec Playwright suite, then run successive gap-closure rounds (round 2 with 7 plans, round 3 with 4 more) driven by live user bug reports until the phase goal is genuinely met.
summary.outcome: All plans (01-33) executed and merged across multiple gap rounds; e2e suite improved from a 6/208 baseline to 165+/208 passing with only two explicitly human-approved deferrals (recovery.html v2-only, rotation-durability SC-4) remaining; phase verification reached round 3 at 4/5 success criteria with one final human decision pending before full closure.

repo: Write plane (WriteChildRef, keyed by node UUID) and read plane (SealedChildRef, keyed by ipnsName) are separate structures in node/v3 — moves must re-home the WriteChildRef from source to dest write-body or the file becomes permanently unsaveable after move (fixed in 68.1-31, client.ts ~1759-1870)
createFolder must set BOTH encryptedIpnsPrivateKey AND keyEpoch on POST /ipns/publish for TEE republish enrollment, otherwise subfolders never get enrolled and die at IPNS TTL (68.1-16)

mock-ipns-routing (tools/mock-ipns-routing, :3001) is an IN-MEMORY store wiped on every container restart — do not restart casually during dev; the API's DB cache (ipns_records table) written synchronously at publish is what makes records durable across mock restarts

mock-ipns-routing healthcheck used busybox `wget localhost` which resolves to ::1 while the app binds IPv4-only — always fails 'unhealthy' even when healthy; fix is `127.0.0.1` in docker-compose.yml healthcheck
API dev server is on :3000, not :3001 (:3001 is the delegated-routing mock) — easy to health-probe the wrong port

dfsFindFolder previously unconditionally re-resolved and overwrote every intermediate ancestor's folderTree entry on every call, even already-loaded write-capable ones — caused breadcrumb-up empty-flash; fixed with a cache short-circuit that only falls through to full recovery for read-only-seeded (zero writeKey) entries

apps/web/public/recovery.html (untouched since Phase 24) only accepts legacy v2 single-key vault blobs and v2 metadata schema — the app has produced v3/node-v3 blobs since Phase 62, making /recovery a known broken path requiring its own gap-closure plan

shares table's plaintext item_name column was fully dropped (not renamed) by migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover, making the REQ-4 itemName backfill feature permanently dead code (shouldBackfill() always false) — required a product decision to retire+redesign encrypted rather than silently 'fix'

SharedFolderState.writeKey was only ever seeded at the share root by 68.1-20 — deep navigation into shared subfolders left writeKey zeroed, blocking nested shared writes until 68.1-30 added a one-hop write-chain resolver
Web3Auth/Core Kit login has real external flakiness (init-hang, degrades through the day) — distinguish from real regressions by re-running the single spec file in isolation
full-workflow.spec.ts test 3.9 was an order-dependent spec race (passes 53/53 isolated, fails only in the 208-spec run) — fixed by editing the spec itself (516cd0ee3), not app code
apps/web has NO unit tests (*.spec.ts under apps/web/src is a hard invariant, SC#5) — all logic lives in packages/sdk / sdk-core with real-crypto unit tests there

code.finding: moveItem re-links the read-plane SealedChildRef but originally left the moved file's WriteChildRef orphaned in the SOURCE write-body — must unseal under source writeKey (keyed by node UUID, not the ipnsName-based childId param), drop from source, re-seal under dest writeKey, preserving dest-before-source publish order

downloadFromIpns originally fed the parent folderKey into sdk-core's resolveFileMetadata instead of the file's own readKey — silent type coincidence (both Uint8Array) caused AEAD decrypt failure surfaced as 'Decryption failed' in the text editor
hardcoded isFolder = true meant the D-02 kind cache populated elsewhere was never consulted in the shared browser, causing files to render/behave as folders

folder:loaded/folder:updated SDK-event handler needed a sequence-aware empty-children guard (68.1-26/68.1-29) plus resolve-before-insert kind-cache ordering (68.1-33) to avoid clobbering already-loaded non-empty folders and to avoid a race where children render before their kind is cached

workflow: Long-running background e2e suites launched by subagents are prone to 'lost wake' — the agent parks waiting for its own background task but the completion notification sometimes never re-invokes it (especially after transcript eviction or account session-limit death); mitigate with an independent orchestrator-side watchdog polling for the result artifact plus a SendMessage resume while the transcript is still warm

When a subagent dies mid-task on an account session limit, the orchestrator can often recover inline: spot-check disk state, validate uncommitted diffs, finish remaining test/fixture fixes directly, and commit — rather than losing the work
1Password git-commit signing produces false-negative timeouts — always verify via `git log -1` before treating a commit as failed
Decision-coverage gate parser requires the tag INSIDE the bold markdown group, e.g. `- **D-04 [informational]:**`, not `- **D-04:** [informational]`

Live user manual testing (headed Playwright runs, actual clicking) surfaced 3+ real bugs (cold-reload nav, text-editor decrypt, subfolder move) that the automated suite structurally could never reach because describe.serial specs abort at first failure and shadow everything downstream — 'suite green' does not mean every code path was exercised

Verification agents should refuse to silently absorb deferred/undispositioned failures into a passing score — round-3 verifier explicitly flagged writable-shares 10.3 as needing its own human sign-off since it hadn't gone through the same AskUserQuestion approval as the other two deferrals

Fixing one bug can unblock previously-unreachable test cases further down a serial spec file, revealing new unrelated pre-existing gaps (10.3 fix unblocked 10.4, which hit an unrelated owner-side kind-cache race)

friction: Wave-1 executor stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls (~23 min), requiring disk spot-check + resume

Exit-gate agents repeatedly lost their wake-up after launching long background e2e runs (recurred across at least 3 separate gap rounds), each time requiring orchestrator-side detection and manual SendMessage resume or a fresh continuation agent
git index.lock contention during tracking commits (transient, resolved by retry)
Two separate subagents (68.1-16, 68.1-24) ran prohibited `git stash push` against shared refs/stash despite explicit instructions not to — required manual cleanup/verification each time
Session/quota limits killed the exit-gate executor mid-closeout twice across different gap rounds, forcing inline orchestrator recovery both times
Watchdog polling for `.last-run.json` failed once because the specific playwright config in use never writes that file — had to fall back to reading raw stdout captures
tail/pipe usage in a gate check masked a real non-zero exit code from a failing sdk test suite, requiring a re-run to see the true failure
